text: Databases store and organize information so we can find it quickly. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases use tables with rows and columns, like a spreadsheet. NoSQL databases are more flexible and store data in different ways, such as documents. To get information from a database, we write queries, which are special commands. Before building a database, we need data modeling, which means planning how the data will be structured. We also use indexes to make searches faster. Good design helps databases work well as they grow.
